title: Interactive battles
hook: **WIP:** turn-based fights on a **battle stage** you play yourself — initiative, action bar, targets, wind-up and interrupt feel. Not finished yet; many web fights still auto-resolve.

blindSpots.meaning: Not finished. You do not yet pilot every turn on a shipped battle stage.
You pick targets and spend actions. Different from watching an auto-resolve report.
Expeditions and many web fights still resolve with the same combat math without you clicking each turn.
The place you fight hands-on — not the lawn board and not the rift map itself.
Auto-resolve and interactive use the same fight language. You feel the roster either way; only the pilot changes.

alsoTrue: Skills and meters that feed the action bar are also WIP — see [skills and loadouts](skills-loadouts) and [actor meters](actor-meters).
Named recipe catalog stays Vision — [named reactions](named-reactions).

sections.title: Not finished yet
paras: Today you feel the roster through auto-resolve more often than through a turn bar you own.
When the battle stage ships, you pilot turns: initiative track, action bar, targets, reactions and counters.

sections.title: What it will feel like
sections.intro: Design shape from the combat pillar:

cards.name: Initiative
cards.body: Who acts when on the track.

cards.name: Action bar
cards.body: What you can spend this turn.

cards.name: Targets
cards.body: You pick who the action hits.

cards.name: Reactions
cards.body: Windows to interrupt, counter, or answer — feel first; named catalog later.

sections.title: Where it hangs
paras: Delves and map fights want this stage. Expeditions can stay auto-resolve on purpose.
Map handoff into battle is its own WIP — [map → battle handoff](map-battle-handoff).

doTitle: What you do while it is WIP
doSteps: Keep sending expeditions and reading returns — auto-resolve is intentional for idle.
Build roster power; the same math will matter when you pilot.
When a battle stage appears in a build, follow on-screen initiative and targeting — do not expect the lawn controls.
doNote: Lawn remains the first core board match — [lawn match](lawn-match). This page is the hands-on stage elsewhere.

mixUps.q: Why don’t I get turns on expeditions?
mixUps.a: Expeditions can stay auto-resolve. Interactive battles are a different place.
No. The lawn stays a live board match. This is a separate battle stage.
No. Same combat language — you just are not piloting each action.

mixUps.q: Where is the battle stage button?
mixUps.a: WIP — not finished. Absence is expected.

mixUps.q: Are named combo recipes required first?
mixUps.a: No. Reaction windows can ship with battles; the named catalog is Vision.
